scope: New and changed claims only; no blanket fact-audit certification of unchanged prose.

new_claims: Default HTTPS port is 443; assignment alone does not prove service security.
TCP connectivity, TLS verification and HTTP responses answer different questions.
curl head/verbose options retain default certificate and hostname verification.
No MX can invoke implicit MX; temporary failure is not an empty answer.
Null MX uses a single 0 . exchange and must not coexist with other MX.
A DNS result does not establish mailbox delivery.
Registrar information does not establish the web-hosting arrangement.
Cloudflare proxied names return shared Cloudflare addresses instead of origin addresses.
IANA accepts domain names, IP addresses and AS numbers.
